description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
